text:
mira: Quick idea — webinar topic: 'Predictable LLM inference: balancing latency, cost, and reliability'. Abstract: show 3 production patterns (routing tiers, KV/prefix caching, quantization profiles) plus a cost/latency benchmark and a live canary fallback demo. Keeping it 45 min. Thoughts?

aj: Love the angle. Keep the marketing hook tight: 'Ship LLM features without surprise cloud bills'. Add a simple benchmark slide comparing default endpoint vs our optimized stack — customers care about the delta.

sam: I can demo canary rollout -> autoscale -> fallback to cheaper quantized variant. Need a short, deterministic script so demo doesn't hit noisy infra. Also want a preloaded sample prompt set.

olivia: Speaker lineup proposal: Mira — opener + customer context; Aj — moderator + narrative; Kai — benchmarks and economics; Sam — live demo + tech Qs. I can handle slide design and social assets.

kai: I'll produce benchmark narrative + 2 graphs: per-token cost vs latency; throughput vs tail latency. Need to confirm which baseline models to compare (open model names). Also will include the quantization tradeoffs slide.

aj: Registration/lead routing: prefer a single registration form with 'primary use case' + 'team size' and a hidden campaign param. Route leads to HubSpot campaign 'webinar_llm_inference_mar2026'. Rules: Enterprise -> sdr-enterprise queue; any demo watcher who clicks 'contact sales' -> immediate alert to sales@; bench-interested -> tag bench.

mira: Draft lead routing rules (confirm):
1) registrant selects 'Enterprise' OR company size > 500 -> assign to sdr-enterprise
2) attendee completes demo interaction (clicks CTA) -> add 'hot-lead' and email sales@redwood.com
3) registrant checks 'benchmarks' -> add tag 'bench' in CRM and include in followup drip 2
Please confirm any changes by EOD Mon.

sam: Rehearsal availability: tech check (mic/screen) Wed 09:00 PT; full run-through Thu 14:00 PT. Recommend we do at least one recorded dry-run with the exact deck + demo script.

olivia: Ops checklist: reminder emails at 48h and 1h, 1-day pre-recorded snippet for socials, post-webinar blog draft + X thread. I'll own reminders + social copy.

mira: Action items (owners + deadlines):
- kai: benchmark slides + CSVs by Tue EOD
- sam: demo script + recorded dry-run by Wed 12:00 PT
- aj: registration form + HubSpot campaign by Mon EOD
- olivia: reminder sequence + social copy by Wed EOD
- mira: slide deck + host notes by Wed EOD
Please update the shared doc with links to slides and data.

calendar-bot: Event created: Webinar rehearsal Thu 2026-03-19 21:00 UTC (full run-through).

mira: Small tech notes for the dry-run:
- Use wired headset, disable notifications, have local fallback recording (OBS)
- Demo VM prewarm (load KV cache) 5 min before start
- Share specific tab for the dashboard; avoid switching to full desktop
- If demo fails, fallback to pre-recorded clip (Sam will prepare 2-min clip)

aj: Moderator script snippet: intro (2m) -> set expectations for Q&A (we'll answer live for 15 min) -> handoff to Kai for benchmarks -> Sam demo -> live Q&A -> CTA + recording link. Keep transitions as '1-2 sentence signposts'.

mira: Thanks everyone — I'll sync with product marketing to see if we can get a customer quote to show on the benchmarks slide. Meeting notes + tasks copied into the project doc.

sam: I'll drop the demo script draft into the shared doc tonight.

olivia: I'll queue the reminder copy and a 1-line social announcement for approvals. :thumbsup:

mira: Great — see you at the dry-run.
